title: How Much Does a Shopify Store Cost in India? (2026 Price Guide)
h1: How Much Does a Shopify Store Cost in India? Complete 2026 Price Breakdown
answer: A professional Shopify store in India typically costs between ₹50,000 to ₹1,20,000 for a theme-configured setup, ₹1,80,000 to ₹4,50,000 for a custom-designed storefront, and ₹5,00,000+ for enterprise or Shopify Plus builds. Additional recurring costs include Shopify subscription plans ($29–$399/mo), domain registration, and payment gateway fees.
metaDescription: Real breakdown of Shopify store development costs in India for 2026. Compare theme setups, custom builds, agency rates, and recurring platform expenses.
author: Ritesh
keyTakeaways: Theme setup: ₹50,000 to ₹1,20,000 (quick 2-week launch)
Bespoke custom store: ₹1,80,000 to ₹4,50,000 (3-5 weeks)
Enterprise / Shopify Plus: ₹5,00,000+ (custom integrations & ERP)
Shopify platform subscription starts at $29/mo (approx ₹2,400/mo)
Indian payment gateway fees range from 1.95% to 2% per transaction

faqs.q: What hidden costs should Indian eCommerce businesses prepare for?
faqs.a: Beyond initial development, budget for paid Shopify apps ($20–$150/mo), domain renewal (₹1,000/yr), payment gateway transaction fees (approx 2%), and COD courier verification services.

faqs.q: Why do custom Shopify stores cost more than theme setups?
faqs.a: Custom stores involve tailored UI/UX design in Figma, bespoke Liquid section programming, zero-bloat code architecture, and rigorous speed optimization designed to maximize conversion rates.

title: How Long Does It Take to Build a Shopify Store?
h1: How Long Does It Take to Build a Shopify Store? Realistic Timelines
answer: Building a standard theme-based Shopify store takes 1 to 2 weeks. A bespoke, custom-designed Shopify storefront takes 3 to 6 weeks, while large-scale enterprise migrations or complex Shopify Plus builds require 6 to 10 weeks depending on catalog complexity and third-party integrations.
metaDescription: Understand realistic Shopify development timelines in 2026. See how long theme setups, custom Liquid themes, and enterprise builds take step by step.
author: Ritesh
keyTakeaways: Standard theme setup: 7–14 days
Custom Figma-to-Liquid store: 3–6 weeks
Complex catalog migration: 4–8 weeks
Main bottleneck is usually client asset delivery (copy, product photography, gateway approvals)

faqs.q: How can we speed up the Shopify development process?
faqs.a: Prepare your product photography, catalog CSVs, brand guidelines, and payment gateway account approvals before the development sprint begins.

title: Shopify vs WooCommerce: Which Is Better in India? (2026 Comparison)
h1: Shopify vs WooCommerce: Which Is Better for Indian D2C Brands?
answer: For Indian D2C brands, Shopify is superior for reliability, checkout speed, zero server maintenance, and automated security. WooCommerce offers lower initial hosting costs but requires constant plugin updates, manual server tuning, and frequent security patches that increase total cost of ownership as sales volume grows.
metaDescription: Unbiased comparison of Shopify vs WooCommerce for Indian eCommerce. Compare hosting, checkout speed, COD handling, maintenance costs, and scalability.
author: Ritesh
keyTakeaways: Shopify has 99.99% uptime with zero server maintenance required
WooCommerce requires manual VPS server management, caching, and security backups
Shopify checkout converts 15-30% higher on mobile due to streamlined payment flows
Both platforms support Indian payment gateways (Razorpay, Cashfree, UPI) and logistics (Shiprocket)

faqs.q: When should an Indian brand move from WooCommerce to Shopify?
faqs.a: When site crashes during sales spikes, checkout slowdowns, or plugin conflicts cost you more in lost revenue and developer maintenance than Shopify's monthly subscription.

title: How to Choose a Shopify Development Company: Evaluation Checklist
h1: How to Choose the Right Shopify Development Company for Your Brand
answer: To choose the right Shopify development company, verify verified live client stores, confirm they write clean native Liquid code rather than relying on heavy page-builder apps, require direct code ownership upon launch, and check for transparent milestone-based billing with post-launch support guarantees.
metaDescription: Step-by-step checklist to evaluate and hire the best Shopify development agency. Avoid red flags, verify portfolio work, and ensure direct code ownership.
author: Ritesh
keyTakeaways: Ask to inspect live client stores on mobile devices
Confirm they build native Liquid sections (OS 2.0) without page-builder dependencies
Ensure 100% theme code ownership and no proprietary locks
Look for clear milestone deliverables: 50% upfront, 50% upon final sign-off

title: 15 Crucial Questions to Ask Before Hiring a Shopify Developer
h1: 15 Questions You Must Ask Before Hiring a Shopify Developer or Agency
answer: Before hiring a Shopify developer, ask: Will you build custom Liquid sections or use a pre-made template? What mobile Core Web Vitals score do you guarantee? Do you transfer 100% code ownership? How do you handle 301 redirects and SEO protection? And what post-launch bug warranty is included?
metaDescription: Essential interview questions before hiring a Shopify agency or freelancer. Protect your store from bloated code, poor mobile speed, and unexpected costs.
author: Ritesh
keyTakeaways: Ask about custom Liquid vs pre-made theme bloat
Verify mobile speed optimization methodologies
Clarify revision rounds and post-launch bug fixes
Confirm milestone billing and NDA availability

title: Will I Lose SEO Rankings When Moving to Shopify? The Migration Truth
h1: Will I Lose Google SEO Rankings When Migrating to Shopify?
answer: You will not lose SEO rankings during a Shopify migration if you execute a strict migration protocol: map 1-to-1 301 redirects for every legacy URL, preserve title tags, meta descriptions, and heading structure, migrate structured data schema, and verify the new sitemap in Google Search Console immediately upon DNS cutover.
metaDescription: Learn how to migrate to Shopify without losing Google organic search traffic or keyword rankings. The exact technical 301 redirect and SEO protection blueprint.
author: Ritesh
keyTakeaways: 100% 1-to-1 301 redirect mapping prevents 404 traffic drops
Preserving URL hierarchy, titles, and schema protects keyword rankings
Faster mobile page load times on Shopify often boost rankings post-migration
Monitor Google Search Console indexing closely for 14 days post-launch
